Dated this the 11th day of January, 2024
 Judgment

The above writ petition is filed with the following prayers:
"(a) Issue a writ of Certiorari or any other appropriate writ order or direction calling for the records leading to Exhibit P2 and P2(a) and quash the same;

(b) Declare that proceedings pursuant to issuance of Exhibit P2 and P2(a) are lapsed in view of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, and whatever proceedings initiated pursuant to Exhibit P2 and P2(a) are a nullity.

sentences.text:
(c) Declare that survey of the petitioner's property and laying of survey stones in the property of the petitioner is illegal and hence the same is a nullity and direct the 7th respondent to remove the survey stones put in the property of the petitioner.
 WP(C) NO.5024 OF 2014  (d) Issue a writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ order or direction commanding the 1st respondent to hold a high level enquiry in to the disbursement and spending of Rs.34.31 Lakhs released to the 6th respondent as per Exhibit P3 order.
(e) Grant such other and further reliefs, which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit to grant in the facts and circumstances of the case."[SIC]
2. When this writ petition came up for consideration on 03.03.2014, this Court passed the following order;
"Admit. Learned Govt. Pleader takes notice for the respondents.
